name: Make Tracks Great Again
storyline:
Once, this railway station stood as the greatest, most profitable, and most incredible transportation hub in the nation—without equal!

For decades it operated in glorious efficiency, with cities daily vying to pack our freight cars to the brim. The volume of orders back then was so overwhelming that the rails nearly buckled under the strain!

Then one day—no one understood why—certain individuals began destroying it all with catastrophically poor decisions!

Now?

Our debts now outnumber the bolts on these rails, and liquidation agents are smirking on the platforms, calculators in hand!
summary: This is a simulation management game about how to Make Tracks Great Again: Only by ensuring trains depart the platform fully loaded with correct cargo can you earn more money and restore the station's greatness.
